scope.claim: exposed cultivated-soil B1 morphology complementary to OPARA-1038
scope.stop_policy: Stop on the first pass; otherwise retain exact metadata no-go reasons and do not expand the tranche.

hard_gates: raw point observations or raw imagery sufficient to reconstruct metric geometry
explicit bare-soil and tillage semantics with acquisition date
reusable public license covering derived and training use
independent checkpoint or control evidence with numeric horizontal and vertical error
documented measured support sufficient to evaluate B1 wavelengths

decision.reason: Neither capped candidate exposes the combination of raw reconstructable geometry, cultivated bare-soil semantics, independent numeric control, and B1 support required before a geometry download.
decision.fallback: Continue the already-selected OPARA-1038 bounded probe; do not download either rejected candidate for target qualification.
not_authorized: treating provider-interpolated DTMs as raw support

dataset.title: Estimating soil surface roughness with models based on the information about tillage practises and soil parameters - dataset
dataset.geography: 18 arable fields in five settlements near Poznan, western Poland
dataset.semantics: Each record binds a field and subfield to the tillage tool used before roughness measurement, soil texture and chemistry, moisture, HSD, and T3D.

blocking_reasons: The official release contains only a 39.0 kB PDF and 38.1 kB XLSX; it publishes roughness indices and covariates, not source photographs, point clouds, or per-cell heights.
The release publishes no independent checkpoint coordinates or numeric horizontal and vertical error for the omitted geometry.
HSD and T3D can condition or validate aggregate regime statistics, but they cannot supervise spatial B1 morphology.
candidates.reusable_role: Aggregate process-prior metadata only; reuse requires a separately qualified geometry source with matching tillage, soil texture, moisture, and season.

dataset.title: Dataset - Evora 2024-2025 - UAV Surveys - Soil Erosion
dataset.geography: vineyards and olive orchards in the Alentejo region near Evora, Portugal
dataset.semantics: Plot treatments are control, mulch, or mulch plus biochar; vegetation and canopy cover are measured rather than the release defining an exposed tilled-soil surface.

official_file_manifest.name: Data - UAV.zip
official_file_manifest.contents_declared_by_publisher: derived DTMs, orthomosaics, accuracy tables, erosion, precipitation, soil roughness, and vegetation-cover data

blocking_reasons: The official 4,444,941,255-byte archive declares derived DTMs and orthomosaics, not raw images or point observations, so provider interpolation and measured support cannot be audited.
The physical regime is Mediterranean vineyard and olive-orchard erosion under mulch and biochar treatments, not exposed Baltic or northern-European tilled soil.
The paper reports vertical DTM-versus-GPS RMSE but no separate numeric horizontal checkpoint error distribution for the released products.
Even the best FEA1 product has 0.042 m vertical RMSE and 0.117 m 95% level of detection; the release cannot identify which B1 relief survives its total measurement and interpolation response.
candidates.reusable_role: No target-qualification role. The GPS-transect design is a useful protocol example, but its derived surfaces and Mediterranean orchard semantics do not complement OPARA-1038 for the frozen claim.
